# S-02 Remaining Tier 2 Fixture

This fixture supports the `s02_remaining_tier2_grounding_v1` campaign.

It is intentionally medium-pressure, not hard/adversarial:

- simple deterministic exports
- unlock/order-looking names
- prerequisite-looking names plus a false-friend distractor
- state-effect style increment/read exports
- no live lane, model, Ghidra, or cross-DLL dependency

The fixture can support Tier 2 evidence for ordering, pass-scope, state-effect, and bottom-up preservation families. It cannot honestly prove lane/runtime failure classification or hard overtrust prevention by itself.
